title: Bug
description: At a rundown desert motel, a woman (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer (Michael Shannon), which quickly degenerates into paranoia after the man insists that he has tiny insects under his skin.

title: Cabin Fever
description: College students (Jordan Ladd, James DeBello, Rider Strong) fall prey to a flesh-eating virus after they head to the woods for a vacation.

title: Cabin Fever 2: Spring Fever
description: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.

title: The Bay
description: The residents of a seaside Maryland community become the unfortunate hosts of mutant, waterborne parasites that take control of their minds and bodies.

title: The Ninth Gate
description: A rare-book broker (Johnny Depp), hired by a wealthy collector (Frank Langella), discovers his latest find may hold the key to summoning Satan.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: After being hypnotized at a party, a man (Kevin Bacon) has visions of deaths and of a girl who disappeared six months earlier.
